content.title: Details & Logistics
content.subtitle: Common inquiries regarding our menu and space.

items.title: Do you offer gluten-free or vegan pastry options?
items.description: Yes, we always have a selection of vegan cookies and gluten-friendly cakes baked daily. Please ask our barista about the daily rotation.

items.title: Where do you source your beans?
items.description: We partner with transparent, direct-trade roasters. Our current house espresso comes from a cooperative in Huehuetenango, Guatemala.

items.title: Is seating available for remote work?
items.description: We offer ample seating with access to outlets and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi on weekdays. On weekends, we operate as a laptop-free space to encourage conversation.

items.title: Can I order whole bean coffee to take home?
items.description: Absolutely. Our retail shelves feature our house blend and rotating single-origins. We are happy to grind them to your preferred brewing method upon request.
